title: 1D/4H demand-paged history: real viewport boundary and reliable 429 retries
changes: Use the actual visible candle count when bounding 1D/4H leftward viewport panning, removing the arbitrary 21-candle overscroll and blank-left region.
Preserve sub-bar floating panning and existing initial 1D 95 / 4H 130 data requests.
When new older OHLC pages arrive, reproject using the existing latest-anchored float offset: older bars join seamlessly and remain available for further user-driven navigation.
Keep pending demand-page retries across changing 429 cooldowns, tab visibility and concurrent 1D/4H requests; no repeated requests while cooling.
Do not mistake a Pionex endpoint that ignored endTime for a genuine history boundary.
Show restored offline deep-history cache as a loaded event; retain existing Pionex-only Worker/R2 and unchanged indicators.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite the 7 radar files on GitHub Pages. This frontend repair keeps the v2.1.29 cloudflare/worker.js unchanged; the existing Worker must already have v2.1.29 history pagination and shared 429 cooldown deployed.
validationNote: Static and mocked browser tests; cannot confirm actual Cloudflare/Pionex historical availability without real authenticated deployment/runtime.
